historicalDriftEvidence.note: Technical baseline-vs-candidate rendered Rich model, source-goal change review and retained-state check; this does NOT confer V2 academic approval.

source_provenance_and_licence.reviewNote: Immutable 2021 source URL, edition and licence are registered and checked.

effective_learner_visible_content.reviewNote: Authenticated Chromium desktop/mobile rendered visible lesson and examples, but not independently certified as complete original student task parity.

student_and_school_isolation.reviewNote: The same controller policy and attempt route handle all 20 scoped code IDs; the real two-school authenticated CI test denied cross-tenant student/assessment/Practice routes. Shared policy proof, NOT twenty separate denial submissions.
